name: Wind Fan
summary: A fan that casts Gust of Wind, at a growing risk of tearing.

stats.effect: While holding this fan, you can cast *{ref:spell/gust-of-wind}* (save DC 13) from it. Each subsequent time the fan is used before the next dawn, it has a cumulative 20 percent chance of not working; if the fan fails to work, it tears into useless, nonmagical tatters.
